reality review: Scheduled events pre-determine outcomes: The world includes scheduled events that send review outcomes on fixed dates (Aug 7, Aug 14) and a 'deadline_notification' sent by Elena Vargas to herself. These events bypass the actor model: the risk team and legal team are participants but their actions are scripted as scheduled sends, not emerging from their own decision-making.
